title: 云原生 Agent Harness：从聊天框走向可协作的工程系统
english: The CNCF Blog argues that coding agents became more useful when they moved beyond a chat-box interaction model. Its summary identifies four changes: capable tools, a shared repository and filesystem, subagents, and skills that preserve what the system has learned. This framing is relevant to cloud-native engineering because it treats an agent as part of an operational environment rather than as an isolated conversational interface. Other supplied updates show adjacent AI activity: OpenAI describes stronger safeguards and support for Australia’s cyber defences, expanded support for the Lenfest AI Collaborative, and a Basis case in which GPT-6 Astra completed a 50-tab tax workbook twice as fast as GPT-5.6 Sol.
chinese: CNCF 博客认为，编码 Agent 真正变得有用，不只是因为模型会聊天，而是因为它获得了更强的工具、共享代码仓库与文件系统、子 Agent，以及能够沉淀系统经验的技能。这一观点把 Agent 放入可执行、可协作的工程环境中，接近云原生平台和运维系统的设计方式。用户提供的其他信息还包括：OpenAI 将加强对澳大利亚网络防御的安全措施与支持；Lenfest AI Collaborative 和 Fellowship Program 获得扩大支持；Basis 表示 GPT-6 Astra 完成一个 50 页签的税务工作簿，速度是 GPT-5.6 Sol 的两倍。
why_it_matters: 对云原生和 Agent Infra 而言，重点从单次对话转向工具调用、共享工作区、子 Agent 编排和经验沉淀。对 AIOps 来说，这提示运维 Agent 需要嵌入真实的仓库、文件系统与执行权限，并配套安全护栏。对职业发展而言，资深运维开发应强化平台工程、自动化编排、权限治理和可观测性，而不只是掌握提示词。
interview_expression: I see agent infrastructure as more than a chat interface: it needs tools, shared workspaces, delegation, and durable skills. In an operations context, I would also prioritize permissions, observability, and safeguards.
